_comment: Recipes for the procedural kit assembler (§28.1a, Phase 1 1f): how a building is built from the Georgian kit. Generic recipes are used by catalogue buildings (buildings/*.json 'recipe'); real_buildings maps timeline ids to their own recipes. Real buildings take their size from their OSM outline; player buildings from their footprint minus margin_m. Every recipe is a PLACEHOLDER: storeys, roofs and details of real buildings are unverified.

defaults._massing_comment: Beyond this distance a building is drawn as a simple block with its roof (a few dozen triangles).

_window_styles_comment: Sash windows drawn by assets/shaders/window.gdshader: columns of panes, and rows in the upper and lower sash.
_walls_comment: Wall finishes: the palette colour that replaces the kit's brick (pal_brick_1). 'clapboard' is painted wood for frame buildings.

frame_one_storey._comment: Small wooden building of the 1820s (recitation hall, steward's hall).

georgian_hall._comment: The generic brick hall: three storeys, hip roof, a three-bay portico and a cupola.

georgian_hall_l._comment: Large generic hall on an L-shaped plan (a wing at the back left).

brick_residence._comment: A plain brick residence hall of the 1820s-30s (gable roof, end chimneys), like North and South Halls.

old_main._comment: Old Main (the first college building). Storeys, roof and cupola are guesses [VERIFY with archival images].

elliott_hall._comment: Elliott Hall: a plain brick residence hall with end chimneys. Storeys and roof form are guesses [VERIFY].

stoddard_hall._comment: Stoddard Hall: built to match Elliott. Storeys and roof form are guesses [VERIFY].

_real_buildings_comment: timeline.json id -> recipe. These are drawn from the kit on their real outline instead of as plain blocks.
